Shin-ei Top Gear VOX WEM Watkins Impressum/legal notice Datenschutzerklärung / EU privacy policy Links & Friends For Sale & Trade Carlsbro Suzz made in England, 1970/80s Here we have an English made Carlsbro Suzz from the late seventies/early eighties. The name is somewhat misleading as it seems to imply that this would be some sort of sustain+fuzz=suzz pedal: However the circuit has more in common with an MXR Distortion +. So it's not a nasty fuzz but rather a basic distortion, that is not bad at all. Add to that the collectibility of those funky enclosure Carlsbro pedals and you may have yourself a winner. Carlsbro Carlsbro "Alu" series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by type volume/amplification sustain browse by enclosure pedal Carlsbro Suzz Published on July 4, 2005 Carlsbro "Alu" series fuzz sustain pedal Information The Carlsbro Suzz is a compact analog fuzz/distortion pedal designed to deliver saturated, harmonically rich tones with adjustable dynamics. As part of Carlsbro's modular effects line, it is housed in a flat metal enclosure with a straightforward interface. The pedal features two rotary controls: Gain, which determines the level of distortion, and Sustain, which adjusts the compression and length of the decay. This combination allows users to shape the fuzz character from short, biting textures to long, sustained saturation. The Suzz is highly responsive to knob settings, requiring careful adjustment to balance output levels and tonal density.
